functions.name: extractPackedChannels
functions.signature: (type $t15) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (param $p5 i32) (param $p6 i32)
functions.notes: Reads the global 4-byte plane-base table at 104976, composes a packed pixel, writes channel-minus-one values and an optional first-zero-channel index.

validation.comparison: Every case asserts the call outcome and all five output words. 24 cases additionally assert all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. Coverage includes all first-zero-channel paths, optional alpha, disabled alpha plane, shift variants, 120 random descriptors and boundary traps.
limitations: Callers own descriptor, format and output pointer validity.
The global base table at 104976 must already be populated, as in the original.
Ledger: 338 client bodies recovered and 3,907 remain machine code.
